note: Regional park 6 km E of Glaslyn on Hwy 3, on the shore of Little Loon Lake, with a 9-hole golf course and a beach. Nightly sites sit behind the shore: the lakeside rows on Gordy's Crescent and Lakeview are lease sites. --Claude
summary: Keep; waterfront downgrade recommended. Park page + Let's Camp: 70 nightly-bookable sites (38 30 A + water, 32 non-electric incl 6 group sites) beside 58 lease sites (~55% nightly); C$27.56-38.59 + tax, C$12/day entry; May 1 - Sep 30; Google 4.5 (70). The open lakeside rows are lease sites; nightly sites sit 30-70 m back behind leases, roads or a treed shore -> lakefront to not waterfront.
flags: WATERFRONT (downgrade recommended, not --AWH): stored 'lakefront' rests on 'serviced camp rows on an open grassy point ... sites near the NE shore'. The park's own map and the Let's Camp site list show the shore rows on that point (Gordy's Crescent / Lakefront, 15C-28C) and along Lakeview (1-43) are LEASE sites, not sold by the night. Nightly electric sites: 0C-10C sit one block inland behind the Gordy's Crescent road, the lease row and spruce rows (~50-75 m from the east shore of the point, imagery around 53.3549,-108.2525); 29C-52C and 1E-7E are inland loops. The only nightly sites near the water are the non-electric 44-48, 45B, 56, 57 at the SE end of the Lakeview strip (around 53.3523,-108.2510), ~30-50 m from the lake behind a continuous treed shore band on Esri z17 (no site photos on Let's Camp or the park sites). On-water fails on the nightly sites; no confirmed sightline -> not waterfront. Lakeview would need photos from 44-48/56/57.
NIGHTLY SHARE: 70 nightly sites (38 serviced + 32 non-serviced) of 128 (58 lease) = ~55%. Weekly to 5-month rates posted beside the daily rates; no wording discouraging nightly guests. Passes.
